name: Deeproot Historian
oracle_text: Merfolk and Druid cards in your graveyard have retrace. (You may cast cards with retrace from your graveyard by discarding a land card in addition to paying their other costs.)
blocked_sentences: Merfolk and Druid cards in your graveyard have retrace

needs.what: a static ability on a permanent that grants retrace to other cards in its controller's graveyard matching a filter (here subtypes Merfolk or Druid, any card type): those cards may be cast from the graveyard by paying their printed cost plus discarding a land card as an additional cost
needs.why_existing_wont_do: retrace exists only as a card-level field on the card being cast (CardDef.retrace / retrace_cost), so it cannot be conferred on other cards.
